scope: 14 exact catalog slugs with registry level I, grade 11 eligibility, and no concrete university benefit before this review
method: Only explicit name-and-profile matches in official university admission-2026 rules or matrices were accepted. Registry level alone was never used to infer a benefit.
record_note: Не прогноз на приём-2027. Все права ниже описывают только приёмную кампанию 2026 года; перед подачей заявления правила следующего года нужно проверить заново.
invariants: no more than one UX benefit exists for a slug+university pair
heterogeneous rights within one university are represented as benefit_type=other
a registry level without an explicit olympiad-name match never creates a benefit
